records.gold_query: SELECT T5.Team_Name, T1.Orange_Cap, T1.Purple_Cap FROM soccer_2016.Season AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS T2 ON T1.Season_Id = T2.Season_Id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player_Match AS T3 ON T2.Match_Id = T3.Match_Id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player AS T4 ON T3.Player_Id = T4.Player_Id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Team AS T5 ON T3.Team_Id = T5.Team_Id GROUP BY T5.Team_Name, T1.Orange_Cap, T1.Purple_Cap
records.old_prediction_query: SELECT DISTINCT T.Team_Name FROM soccer_2016.Season AS S INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player_Match AS PM1 ON PM1.Player_Id = S.Orange_Cap INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS M1 ON M1.Match_Id = PM1.Match_Id AND M1.Season_Id = S.Season_Id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player_Match AS PM2 ON PM2.Player_Id = S.Purple_Cap INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS M2 ON M2.Match_Id = PM2.Match_Id AND M2.Season_Id = S.Season_Id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Team AS T ON T.Team_Id = PM1.Team_Id AND T.Team_Id = PM2.Team_Id
records.new_prediction_query: SELECT T1.Season_Year, T3.Team_Name FROM soccer_2016.Season AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player_Match AS T2 ON T2.Player_Id = T1.Orange_Cap OR T2.Player_Id = T1.Purple_Cap INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Team AS T3 ON T2.Team_Id = T3.Team_Id GROUP BY T1.Season_Year, T3.Team_Name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Player_Id = T1.Orange_Cap THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Player_Id = T1.Purple_Cap THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

records.question: 在Mary Smith租借电影的次数中，有多少次发生在2005年6月？
records.gold_query: SELECT COUNT(T1.customer_id) FROM movie_3.payment AS T1 INNER JOIN movie_3.customer AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T2.first_name = 'MARY' AND T2.last_name = 'SMITH' AND STRFTIME('%Y',T1.payment_date) = '2005' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.payment_date) = '6'
records.old_prediction_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movie_3.rental r JOIN movie_3.customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.first_name = 'Mary' AND c.last_name = 'Smith' AND r.rental_date LIKE '2005-06%'
records.new_prediction_query: SELECT COUNT(T2.rental_id) FROM movie_3.customer AS T1 INNER JOIN movie_3.rental AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'MARY' AND T1.last_name = 'SMITH' AND T2.rental_date LIKE '2005-06%'
